sentences.text: HON'BLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. MANINDRA MOHAN SHRIVASTAVA HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GANESH RAM MEENA Judgment 05/05/2023 Heard.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he may be granted some more time to place on record the representation seeking compensation.
The scope of the appeals is confined to the relief sought in the writ petitions which do not relate to compensation.

The learned Single Judge in the impugned order has rightly observed that challenge to the notifications is not maintainable in view of earlier orders by which challenge to the land acquisition proceedings was repelled.
It appears that on an oral submission made before this Court, this Court in its order dated 11.01.2023 observed with regard to petitioners' grievance regarding non-payment of compensation.

Since the pleadings in the writ petitions and the writ appeals do not contain anything with regard to non-payment of compensation but merely challenge the acquisition proceedings under the notification, we are not inclined to keep these appeals pending.
Challenge to the order passed by the learned Single (4 of 4) [SAW-29/2022] Judge is not based on valid ground, therefore, these appeals are dismissed.
It is open for the petitioners to claim compensation, if not paid.

We make it clear that the non-payment of compensation or claim of developed plots in lieu of compensation would be the aspect requiring consideration and no other issue before the land acquisition authorities.

Further,
we also make it clear that issue of determination of compensation is also not open to challenge in view of earlier orders.

That is to say except claim of payment of compensation which has already been determined, if not paid or claim of developed plot in lieu of compensation could be agitated by the appellants before the competent authority.
It goes without saying that if the grievance is not redressed, it will be open for the petitioners to take appropriate remedy.
The special appeals (writ) are dismissed with aforesaid observations.

It is made clear that the order passed by the Civil Court will not come in the way of appellants seeking appropriate remedy with regard to non-payment in the matter of claiming compensation or developed plot, if not already granted.
Copy of this order be placed on record in connected files.

(GANESH RAM MEENA),J (MANINDRA MOHAN SHRIVASTAVA),ACTING CJ PCG/ ARTI SHARMA /21-23 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
